snippets.snippet_text: "Here at Domestika, various payment methods are enabled depending on where you are located*, this way you can complete your purchases in the way that best suits you! Below, you can find the details of each method: In order to enroll in Domestika's courses, you can make the payment with a credit or debit card (we accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discovery, JCB, UnionPay, Elo, Hipercard, BBVA Bancomer and Santander). Make sure your card is enabled to be used for online purchases in international stores."

"Remember that we are a company based in the USA and that all payments that are made via the website are charged in USD. That said, you would need to bear in mind the exchange rate in addition to the commission that your bank or payment processor would take. This information is included on the website and is shown before the payment confirmation, both in your cart and during the purchase process."
